prompt: I just added a new `formatCurrency` utility function and its usage in a component in this npm-based TypeScript repo. Verify the change is done.
assertions: Output runs format:check, lint, test (run or coverage), and build in that order
Output runs them from the repo root
Output reports the change as done only after all four commands succeed
Output does not skip straight to declaring success without actually running the commands

prompt: I edited src/utils/formatDate.ts to add a new export. Run the definition-of-done check. (Assume `npm run lint` fails with an unused-variable error in the edited file.)
assertions: Output surfaces the lint failure rather than ignoring it or reporting success
Output fixes the underlying issue (or clearly states what needs fixing) before considering the task complete
Output re-runs lint (or the full sequence) after the fix to confirm it now passes
Output does not report the task done while a check is still failing

prompt: I fixed a typo in a single error message string inside one function in src/lib/validate.ts. What should I run to confirm this is done?
assertions: Output recommends the smallest relevant check for this localized edit (e.g. lint and/or the focused test file) rather than requiring the full format/lint/test/build sequence
Output does not insist on a full deploy-shaped build for this small change
Output does not treat this as requiring the pr-ready full-coverage flow
